# metawoRld

Structured, validated, version-controlled data for living systematic
reviews.

A metawoRld project is a folder (usually a Git repository) holding:

- the review’s settings and screening criteria (`_metawoRld.yml`),
- a schema describing what is extracted from each study
  (`_extraction_schema.yml`),
- one folder per study with `metadata.yml` and `data.csv`,
- meta-analyses defined in `_analyses.yml`, re-run whenever data change,
- a Quarto dashboard website (summary of findings, forest plots,
  cumulative meta-analyses, results per variable) that can be published
  automatically.

It works on its own with manual data entry, and with
[DataFindR](https://github.com/andjar/DataFindR), which uses LLMs to
screen studies and extract data into the project.

See
[`vignette("getting_started")`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/articles/getting_started.md)
and
[`vignette("conceptual_overview")`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/articles/conceptual_overview.md).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("andjar/metawoRld")
remotes::install_github("andjar/DataFindR")   # optional, for LLM screening/extraction
```

## Example

``` r

library(metawoRld)

create_metawoRld(
  "my_review",
  project_name = "Biomarker X in pregnancy",
  project_description = "Living review of maternal serum levels of X.",
  inclusion_criteria = c("Human pregnancy", "Serum or plasma X reported"),
  exclusion_criteria = c("Animal study", "Review or case report")
)

add_study_data("my_review", "10.1000/abc", metadata = list(...), data = my_data_frame)
validate_world("my_review")
world <- load_metawoRld("my_review")
generate_website("my_review")
```

## Main functions

| Task | Function |
|----|----|
| Create a project / refresh templates | [`create_metawoRld()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/create_metawoRld.md), [`use_templates()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/use_templates.md) |
| Add data | [`add_study_data()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_study_data.md), [`add_study_template()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_study_template.md) |
| Validate | [`validate_study()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_study.md), [`validate_world()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_world.md), [`validate_against_schema()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_against_schema.md), [`validate_links()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_links.md) |
| Load | [`load_metawoRld()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/load_metawoRld.md), [`read_study()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_study.md), [`list_studies()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/list_studies.md) |
| Review values against the papers | [`review_values()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/review_values.md), [`check_values()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/check_values.md), [`verification_status()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/verification_status.md), [`set_verification()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/set_verification.md), [`update_data_point()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/update_data_point.md) |
| Value rules (`_rules.yml`) | [`read_rules()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_rules.md), [`add_variable_synonym()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_variable_synonym.md), [`canonical_variable()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/canonical_variable.md) |
| Living meta-analysis (`_analyses.yml`) | [`read_analyses()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_analyses.md), [`run_meta_analysis()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/run_meta_analysis.md), [`run_all_meta_analyses()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/run_all_meta_analyses.md), [`summary_of_findings()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/summary_of_findings.md), [`plot_forest()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_forest.md), [`plot_cumulative()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_cumulative.md), [`plot_variable()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_variable.md), [`to_mean_sd()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/to_mean_sd.md) |
| Website dashboard | [`generate_website()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/generate_website.md), [`generate_dashboard()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/generate_dashboard.md), [`use_github_action_quarto()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/use_github_action_quarto.md) |
| Identifiers | [`normalize_identifier()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/normalize_identifier.md), [`sanitize_id()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/sanitize_id.md), [`desanitize_id()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/sanitize_id.md) |

# Package index

## Projects

- [`create_metawoRld()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/create_metawoRld.md)
  : Create a new metawoRld project
- [`use_templates()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/use_templates.md)
  : Add or update the schema and prompt templates in a project
- [`read_config()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_config.md)
  : Read the project configuration
- [`get_schema()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/get_schema.md)
  : Read a schema from a metawoRld project

## Study data

- [`add_study_data()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_study_data.md)
  : Add a study to a metawoRld project
- [`add_study_template()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_study_template.md)
  : Create template files for manual data entry
- [`read_study()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_study.md)
  : Read one study from a metawoRld project
- [`list_studies()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/list_studies.md)
  : List the studies in a project
- [`load_metawoRld()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/load_metawoRld.md)
  : Load all studies of a metawoRld project

## Validation

- [`validate_study()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_study.md)
  : Validate one study
- [`validate_world()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_world.md)
  : Validate all studies in a project
- [`validate_against_schema()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_against_schema.md)
  : Validate data against a metawoRld schema
- [`validate_links()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/validate_links.md)
  : Validate links between data points and metadata
- [`schema_refs()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/schema_refs.md)
  : List the cross-references defined in a schema
- [`schema_col_types()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/schema_col_types.md)
  : Column types for a study's data.csv derived from the schema

## Reviewing values

- [`review_values()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/review_values.md)
  [`review_values_app()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/review_values.md)
  : Review extracted values against the papers
- [`check_values()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/check_values.md)
  : Check extracted values for plausibility and consistency
- [`verification_status()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/verification_status.md)
  : Verification status of data points
- [`set_verification()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/set_verification.md)
  : Record the verification of data points
- [`update_data_point()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/update_data_point.md)
  : Correct a data point
- [`read_rules()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_rules.md)
  : Read the project's value rules
- [`add_variable_synonym()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/add_variable_synonym.md)
  : Add a variable or synonym to the project's rules
- [`canonical_variable()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/canonical_variable.md)
  : Map variable names to their canonical names

## Meta-analysis

- [`read_analyses()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/read_analyses.md)
  : Read the project's meta-analysis definitions
- [`analysis_data()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/analysis_data.md)
  : Data used in a meta-analysis
- [`run_meta_analysis()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/run_meta_analysis.md)
  : Run a meta-analysis
- [`run_all_meta_analyses()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/run_all_meta_analyses.md)
  : Run all meta-analyses of a project
- [`summary_of_findings()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/summary_of_findings.md)
  : Summary of findings table
- [`plot_forest()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_forest.md)
  : Forest plot of a meta-analysis
- [`plot_cumulative()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_cumulative.md)
  : Cumulative meta-analysis plot
- [`plot_variable()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/plot_variable.md)
  : Plot all reported values of a variable
- [`to_mean_sd()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/to_mean_sd.md)
  : Convert summary statistics to mean and SD
- [`group_category()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/group_category.md)
  : Assign study groups to group categories
- [`rules_for_prompt()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/rules_for_prompt.md)
  : The project vocabulary formatted for an LLM prompt

## Website

- [`generate_website()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/generate_website.md)
  : Generate (and render) the project website
- [`generate_dashboard()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/generate_dashboard.md)
  : Generate the dashboard pages of the website
- [`generate_study_webpage()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/generate_study_webpage.md)
  : Generate one web page per study
- [`use_github_action_quarto()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/use_github_action_quarto.md)
  : Add a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the website

## Identifiers

- [`normalize_identifier()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/normalize_identifier.md)
  : Normalize study identifiers
- [`identifier_type()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/identifier_type.md)
  : Detect the type of a study identifier
- [`sanitize_id()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/sanitize_id.md)
  [`desanitize_id()`](https://andjar.github.io/metawoRld/reference/sanitize_id.md)
  : Encode an identifier so it can be used as a file or folder name
